_comment: D13-F7: every D-13 endpoint request -> response body + status, incl all error bodies and DRF failure shapes. Route paths verbatim from urls.py/web_urls.py; mounts: daemon /api/v1/runner/, web /api/runners/.

DELETE_runners_rid.auth: RunnerAccessTokenAuthentication (mt_ + runner id, or legacy JWT)

errors.when: auth failure incl runner_not_found (row already deleted)

DELETE_runners_rid.ok: 204 empty. revoke(self_revoked) [no-op safe] + send_to_runner {type:revoke, reason:self_revoked} + close_runner_session + DELETE row. Second DELETE -> 401 (row gone: runner_not_found at auth). A REVOKED-but-present row ALSO 401s at auth (runner_revoked) before the view runs — the view's revoke() no-op idempotency is unreachable for already-revoked rows.

GET_health.auth: none (AllowAny) + AnonRateThrottle 30/min (inherits DEFAULT_THROTTLE_CLASSES — no override; unauthenticated callers only)
GET_health.quirk: PROTOCOL_VERSION=3 here, but enroll/create bodies report protocol_version 4 — port both verbatim

GET_projects.auth: RunnerAccessTokenAuthentication, APIKeyAuthentication, BaseSessionAuthentication (first non-None wins; any AuthenticationFailed -> 401 immediately)
GET_projects.note: SAME view as web GET_projects; daemon callers normally use the mt_/JWT runner branch.
GET_projects.ok: 200 [<project rows>] (see web GET_projects for shape; runner branch scopes to runner.workspace_id, ignores ?workspace)

POST_desktop_enroll.auth: session + IsDesktopSession (403 {'error': 'desktop_session_required', 'detail': ...} when not a desktop session; anonymous -> 403 too, NOT 401 — no IsAuthenticated gate)

body.error_description: Pi Dash Desktop <floor> or newer is required.

errors.when: version floor fail (floor interpolated from settings; empty floor never fails)

POST_desktop_enroll.ok: 201 {dev_machine_id, machine_token (raw, shown ONCE), workspace_slug, managed_runner_enabled (bool(settings)), graceful_stop_seconds (int settings)}. Idempotent per (user, workspace, host_label+token-workspace): re-POST rotates the token onto the same machine row.

DELETE_desktop_enroll.body_or_query: host_label from body OR query (stripped [:255]); blank -> ALL the user's bundled machines
DELETE_desktop_enroll.ok: 204 always (no machines -> 204 without tx; else revoke tokens + mark bundled runners offline, rows survive)

errors.when: no marker OR marker bound to another machine (same body — no leak)

POST_machine_command_result.ok: 204 empty. Writes {status, dev_machine_id, runner_id str, runner_name, error, reported_at} TTL 900.

POST_machine_tokens_redeem.auth: none (AllowAny) + AnonRateThrottle 30/min -> 429 throttle shape on excess

errors.when: user/workspace row gone (or payload keys missing)
bootstrap finds an existing active token (redeem does NOT rotate)

POST_runners.auth: X-Api-Key (MachineToken mt_ or APIToken) + IsAuthenticated. mt_ branch: workspace_slug forced to token.workspace.slug (body mismatch -> 404 workspace_not_found); token-bound dev_machine forced (body mismatch -> 403 dev_machine_token_mismatch); host_label defaults from token.

errors.when: mt_ bound to a machine AND body dev_machine_id names a different one
explicit slug miss/non-member (same body); mt_ slug mismatch

body.error_description: Caller is not a member of any workspace.
Caller belongs to multiple workspaces — pass workspace_slug to pick one.

errors.when: no explicit pod hit AND no project default (unknown pod NAME falls through to default — never 404)

body.error_description: This project already has a Pi Dash Agent registered for you on a machine.

POST_runners.note: Desktop-bundled re-enrollment on an existing machine reuses the live bundled runner row (200-shape body, still 201) WITHOUT minting a machine token. APIToken callers (no mt_) + host_label get _rotate_machine_token + their CLI device APIToken deactivated.
POST_runners.ok: 201 {runner_id, runner_name, refresh_token: '', access_token: '', access_token_expires_at: <now iso> (!), refresh_token_generation, workspace_slug, pod_slug (= pod NAME, not slug), project_identifier, long_poll_interval_secs: 25, protocol_version: 4, machine_token_minted: bool, [machine_token]}

POST_runners_enroll.auth: none (AllowAny) + AnonRateThrottle 30/min -> 429 throttle shape on excess
POST_runners_enroll.body: {enrollment_token (16-128 chars), dev_machine_id? (uuid), host_label (required), name? (charset), os?/arch?/version? (<=32)} — DRF validation errors (see F2) -> 400

errors.when: no runner carries the hash (miss reads as expired, not 404)

POST_runners_enroll.ok: 201 {runner_id, runner_name, refresh_token (rt_), access_token (JWT), access_token_expires_at (iso), refresh_token_generation: 1, workspace_slug, pod_slug (= pod NAME), project_identifier, long_poll_interval_secs: 25, protocol_version: 4, machine_token_minted: bool, [machine_token]} — machine_token present ONLY when bootstrap minted (key ABSENT otherwise)

POST_runners_refresh.auth: RunnerRefreshTokenAuthentication (parse only; Bearer REQUIRED — missing -> 401 missing_refresh_token FROM THE VIEW, not the auth class)

errors.when: runner miss OR hash matches neither current nor previous (same body — no leak)
owner no longer member -> runner.revoke('membership_revoked') THEN 401

POST_runners_refresh.ok: 200 {refresh_token (new rt_), access_token (JWT, rtg=new generation), access_token_expires_at, refresh_token_generation}. Force-refresh row deleted in-tx.

method: Every body/status transcribed from the cited view lines; route paths from urls.py/web_urls.py + mounts in pi_dash/urls.py. DRF shapes from F4.
trace: apps/api/pi_dash/runner/views/enrollment.py (enroll, refresh, self-revoke, create, ticket, redeem, invite, revive)

body.error: pod has runners; move or revoke them first
pod has non-terminal runs; cancel or wait
cannot delete the project's default pod; promote another pod to default first

errors.when: miss OR non-viewable (non-owner reads as missing)
viewable but not manageable (unreachable for PRIVATE)

GET_dev_machines.ok: 200 [DevMachineSerializer...] (scoped + annotated per M-series; []) when no machines)

GET_projects.auth: 3 modes in class order (see daemon GET_projects)

errors.when: no credentials at all (anonymous through all three classes)
?workspace= given but no WorkspaceMember row (NO is_active filter — quirk)

GET_projects.ok: 200 [{id, identifier, name, description, is_default, default_pod_id|null, pod_count, pods:[{id, name, is_default}]}] — ?workspace= scopes to one; else ALL membership workspaces concatenated (no is_active filter, DB order)

GET_runners.ok: 200 [RunnerSerializer...] (?workspace= required; ?pod=, ?project= narrow; bundled excluded unless ?include_bundled=1/true/yes; order -updated_at)

PATCH_pods_pid.auth: session + IsAuthenticated; manage = admin OR creator else 403
PATCH_pods_pid.body: {name?, description?, is_default?} (only present keys; name '' -> 400; bare suffix re-prefixed; validator -> 400 {error}; promote demotes project siblings in-tx; demote allowed -> project may hold NO default)

PATCH_runners_rid.body: {name?, pod?} — name '' -> 400; pod: locked read, miss/deleted -> 400 'pod does not exist or has been deleted', cross-workspace -> 400 'pod is in a different workspace', real move with bound non-terminal run -> 409 runner_busy (+code)

body.error: pod does not exist or has been deleted
pod is in a different workspace
runner has an in-flight or queued run; wait for it to finish or cancel it first

POST_dev_machines_create_runner.body: {project (required), name? ([:128], charset), pod? (NOT validated — passed through to the daemon verbatim), agent? (default claude-code), working_dir?, model?, reasoning_effort?}

errors.when: workspace row gone (member but row deleted)
MachineOfflineError (offline-reject type); result marker overwritten to {status:error, error:machine_offline}
enqueue returned None (Redis down); marker -> {status:error, error:delivery_failed}. Other exceptions are LOGGED and treated as delivered (response 202) — port as-is.
machine miss OR out of workspace scope

POST_dev_machines_revoke.ok: 200 DevMachineSerializer (machine revoked_at set when unset + tokens revoked + runners revoked w/ frames + sessions closed, all in-tx)

POST_dev_machines_rotate.ok: 200 DevMachineSerializer (tokens revoked + revoke frames + sessions closed; runner ROWS untouched)

POST_invites.ok: 410 {'error': 'legacy_enrollment_disabled', 'error_description': 'Use `pidash auth login` and `pidash runner add` to register runners.'} — ALWAYS (deprecated mint route)

POST_machine_token_tickets.docstring_quirk: enrollment.py:799-805 docstring claims POST /api/v1/workspaces/<ws>/machine-tokens/tickets/ — STALE; the wired route is below (web_urls.py:83-87)

errors.when: UNREACHABLE via the wired route (web_urls <uuid:workspace_id> converter 404s on a non-UUID segment before the view runs) — defensive branch in view code only (enrollment.py:811-817)
non-member (LOWERCASE+SPACE form — byte-oddity vs workspace_not_found elsewhere)

POST_machine_token_tickets.ok: 201 {ticket (uuid4 hex), expires_in_secs: 60} — EVEN WHEN Redis is None (write skipped, ticket unusable)

POST_pods.auth: session + IsAuthenticated; ADMIN required (role>=20) — stricter than rename/delete (admin-or-creator)
POST_pods.body: {project (uuid, required), name (required, bare suffix re-prefixed), description? (or '')}
POST_pods.ok: 201 PodSerializer (is_default always False; runner_count 0; IntegrityError on (project,name) NOT caught -> 500)

POST_runners_revive.ok: 410 {'error': 'legacy_enrollment_disabled', 'error_description': 'Delete this runner and run `pidash runner add` from the authenticated target machine.'} — ALWAYS

POST_runners_revoke.ok: 200 RunnerSerializer — idempotent: already-revoked returns current state with NO frame/close; else revoke(manual_revoke) in-tx, then frame 'revoked by user' + close + re-read
